content: {"praised":["Charming and endearing story with fine acting and heart.","Ann‑Margret brings goodwill and strong performance.","Supporting cast is great and memorable.","Themes encourage following your heart and new possibilities.","Casting, especially Brenda Vaccaro, is excellent."],"criticized":["Film is cliche‑ridden with overused plot devices.","Story feels musty and formulaic.","“Follow your dreams” trope is too obvious.","Characters lack depth and originality.","Pacing feels slow and repetitive."]}
